title: LISTEN AND SPEAK FAIRLY: A STUDY ON SEMANTIC GENDER BIAS IN SPEECH INTEGRATED LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model outputs across four semantic-related speech tasks: 1) measuring accuracy and stereotypical gender inflections in speech-to-text translation using the WinoST dataset, 2) assessing coreference resolution of gendered pronouns to occupational stereotypes using the WinoBias dataset, 3) calculating stereotypical selection rates in spoken sentence continuation using the StereoSet dataset, and 4) measuring bias scores in multiple-choice question answering for ambiguous and disambiguous contexts targeting binary gender and transgender identities using the BBQ and CBBQ datasets.
